title: Uncraftable Crafting Tables
description: Makes the crafting table uncraftable. There is more into it, I promise!
body:
# Uncraftable Crafting Tables
Removes the crafting recipe for the crafting table. Crafting table no longer drops itself, instead it collapses into some planks and sticks when broken. 

So, now you might be thinking, what would I ever use this datapack? it should make interesting gameplay interactions by forcing players to live in places, where crafting tables have spawned naturally. If they want to live somewhere else, they will have to work for it. Players need to push crafting tables to their wanted position, you could for example equip it to a slime block machine or push it slowly towards your goal. Might even make funny player interactions when someone starts hoarding crafting tables or stealing them from bases.

Also, if there are no crafting tables nearby, you can still obtain some from the wandering trader, which may sell 1 crafting table for 32 emeralds. 

## Config

change the chance of wandering trader selling crafting tables using this command: 
scoreboard players set #knize.nct_chance randomnumber <any number between 1 and 1000>

default is 250 (so 25% chance)
